# Verbatim excerpts of the upstream STT server, recorded for the lean drift tests
# (tests/test_supervised_contract.py, tests/test_macos_catalog_drift.py), which cannot import it.
# release: pipecat-local-stt-server 0.5.0 (tag v0.5.0, commit 8555dbdb799e61036d731a2ef63a7a99cfbb62a5)
# Re-record from the new tag whenever ServiceCatalog.sttServerRequirement moves; the tests check
# that the release above is the one the app installs.
## stt_server/supervise.py
CODE_MODULE_NOT_FOUND = "ModuleNotFoundError"
CODE_ADDR_IN_USE = "EADDRINUSE"
CODE_ACCESS_DENIED = "EACCES"
CODE_MODEL_DOWNLOAD = "ModelDownloadError"
CODE_CONFIG = "ConfigError"
CODE_BACKEND_START = "BackendStartError"
CODE_MODEL_INVALID = "ModelInvalidError"
## stt_server/backends/__init__.py
DEFAULT_MLX_MODEL = "mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo"
DEFAULT_PARAKEET_MODEL = "mlx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3"
DEFAULT_NEMOTRON_MODEL = "mlx-community/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b"
DEFAULT_KYUTAI_MODEL = "kyutai/stt-1b-en_fr-mlx"
BACKENDS: dict[str, BackendEntry] = {
    "echo": BackendEntry(None, None, None),
    "mlx": BackendEntry("stt_server.backends.mlx_whisper", "MLXWhisperBackend", DEFAULT_MLX_MODEL),
    "parakeet": BackendEntry(
        "stt_server.backends.parakeet", "ParakeetBackend", DEFAULT_PARAKEET_MODEL
    ),
    "nemotron": BackendEntry(
        "stt_server.backends.nemotron", "NemotronBackend", DEFAULT_NEMOTRON_MODEL
    ),
    # The kyutai loader fetches by Hub repo id (``hf_hub_download``) only.
    "kyutai": BackendEntry(
        "stt_server.backends.kyutai",
        "KyutaiBackend",
        DEFAULT_KYUTAI_MODEL,
        local_model_paths=False,
    ),
}
